item.title: How to install Git on Linux
item.description: Installing Git on Linux enables version control and collaboration for development workflows across all Linux distributions. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve guided thousands of Linux developers through Git installation for contributing to our repositories. From my expertise, the most reliable approach is using your distribution’s package manager. This method provides automatic updates, system integration, and dependency management.
